topic: NRI basics: what FATCA means in plain words

slides.headline: Tax residency forms, explained in plain words
slides.subhead: Why investors are asked to declare where they pay tax.

points.title: The form
points.text: A self-declaration of the country where you are tax resident.

points.title: Why it is asked
points.text: Institutions collect it under reporting rules such as FATCA and CRS.

points.title: Your part
points.text: Answer honestly and keep your details up to date.

slides.headline: Clear forms. Calm investing.
slides.cta: Save this for your KYC checklist
slides.footnote: Rules differ by country. This is general information.

caption: Tax residency forms can look confusing, but the idea is simple: investors declare which country they pay tax in. Answer honestly and keep your details current. #NRIInvesting #KYC #FATCA #MutualFunds #InvestInIndia
